_readme: HAND-WRITTEN every iteration by Claude (or the agent doing the build): what Claude is LOOKING FOR this version. Only put questions here that ONLY the user can answer (real GPU frame rate, phone feel, 'does X look right'). Then run: node tools/build-claude-check.mjs --version <Vnnn> --categories "<names>" . kinds: text | yesno | choice (needs choices) | number. device: any | desktop | phone | touch | gpu.
summary: V190: OmniStar tab (Docs, OmniStarLight Ctrl/Cmd+K), compass as its own draggable panel, OmniNotify under the profile, hands-tab dividers, centre reticle, floor 20 textures, bottom X meter + session clock, click-empty-space releases orbit, smaller boot star with shooting stars + dev intro settings

asks.question: Is the StarLight Available / Unavailable rule right (planned items and developer tools count as Unavailable)?
asks.why: There is no role system yet, so I used: not built = Unavailable, dev tools Unavailable unless dev mode.

asks.question: Is Ctrl/Cmd+K OK for OmniStarLight?
asks.why: Browsers use it for the address bar; I block that only inside the app.

asks.question: Is the centre reticle what you imagined at 15% opacity?
asks.why: Five thin rings with ticks, arcs and cross marks, slowly turning; 'multi tech circle' was my reading.

asks.question: Is the compass panel's default spot OK (free spot, draggable)?
asks.why: It no longer sits under the logo; position is saved when you drag it.

asks.question: Is OmniNotify now where you wanted (under your profile)?
asks.why: I used the profile column's x.

asks.question: Is the landed star about the right size (about 1.3x the glyph)?
Do the boot shooting stars feel right?
asks.why: Judged only from screenshots; opacity, rate and angle are guesses.

asks.question: Is the session-time readout (left edge under the top-left hand) comfortable?
Does click-empty-space release the orbit without annoying you when you rotate?
asks.why: Drag, long press, right-click and UI clicks are ignored by design.

asks.question: Does the app start and look the same as V188 (boot, ribbon, compass, a panel)?
asks.why: V189 adds only a pure module nothing imports yet, so nothing should change; this is a cheap sanity check.

asks.question: Does the userCompass look right in its slot under the logo?
asks.why: Only judged in screenshots from software-rendered Chromium at six window sizes; line weight, brightness and size are taste. If it is too small, too big or touches something, say what in the message.

asks.question: Is the difference between Left, Center and Right alignment noticeable enough?
asks.why: The slot is only as wide as the top-left hand (103 px) and the globe is 44 px, so the globe moves about 26 px between Left and Center. A wider slot is one constant if you want more room.

asks.question: How does the spin speed feel (Normal = 14 s per turn)?
asks.why: Speeds are a guess: Slow 28 s, Normal 14 s, Fast 7 s. It rides the app ticker, so on a real GPU it should be smooth; I only saw it at about 1 fps in the software renderer.

asks.question: What should clicking the userCompass do? (today: it opens Admin > UI Settings > userCompass)
asks.why: It had to do something, so it opens its own settings. A compass could instead reset the camera heading to north, snap the view to look north, or open the camera idea later. Write what you want.

asks.question: On a narrow window or a phone the globe is hidden (the ribbon covers its strip). Do you want it visible there too?
asks.why: Below about 1010 px the ribbon runs under the whole bar, so there is no free strip. Showing it would mean giving the ribbon a 103 px left margin (tabs shrink) or putting the globe somewhere else. Say which you prefer in the message.

knownIssues: V190 was built in two parts and merged (main.js merged cleanly); only software-GL Chromium and jsdom were used. Nothing was judged on a real GPU, phone or touch device.
The in-scene HelpNode is NOT built; Docs is a DOM panel only. Hook: OmniDocsPanel.openDocs.
External controls (OmniPointing) got no session clock: it has no readout area.
Floor textures are still not in export/import (floor-plane is not in KNOWN_NAMESPACES).
On a phone an open Inspector can cover the ribbon dropdown and the meter gear.
V189 shipped with an empty utils/DevOmniStoreData.js (my error); fixed in the re-issued V189 zip and in V190.
The address type letters (C core, B branch, S space) and the eye symbol are PLACEHOLDERS until the owner picks glyphs; nothing in the app uses OmniAddress yet.
The userCompass was judged only in software-GL Chromium (six window sizes); never on a real GPU, a real phone or with touch.

The userCompass is free only while the ribbon starts to the right of its strip: windows narrower than about 1010 px, phones, tablets and a floated OmniNotify box hide it (it never overlaps the ribbon).
The userCompass slot is the top-left hand's width (103 px); the empty space up to the OmniNotify box (x 222) is not used.
The camera feature is only documented (docs/omniproducts/OMNICAMERA_IDEA.md); seven questions for the owner are still open.
The boot animation, the shooting star and the window resize / maximize were never judged on a real GPU, a real phone or with touch (software-GL Chromium only).
